study: multimodel: a multi-model wind centre for the logit consensus features and the Part B paths
registered_before: any centre or end-to-end score of the new models had been computed (only the archive depth and the Open-Meteo latency metadata were looked at)
motivation: experiments/partb/REPORT.md: adding ICON-D2 to the ECMWF centre moved the Part A end-to-end OD Brier 0.0450 -> 0.0408 (DEFAULT_IFS vs DEFAULT); spread / bias re-tuning of the paths (DEFAULT_NATIVE, gust_metar, recalibration) never moved it. No as-issued ensemble history exists (Open-Meteo single-runs and previous-runs serve no ecmwf_ifs025_ensemble / icon_*_eps runs, probed 2026-11-05).

existing: icon_d2 filled by icon_eu (as in production)
models.selection: none: every added model is used; buffers = measured Open-Meteo availability lag + >= 1 h

primary_consensus: C = 0.5 * IFS + 0.5 * mean(all non-IFS models available at that lead), in (u, v); each model as of its own buffer (latest init <= issue - buffer), a model missing at a lead drops out of the non-IFS mean; IFS only where no other model has the lead. This keeps the production structure (0.5 IFS + 0.5 ICON) and replaces 'ICON' by the mean of all other models.

uses.logit: tw25_cons and tw25_cons_roll6 of the harness table recomputed from C (same definitions, same columns); production spec unchanged, weekly walk-forward refit (experiments.harness.production_preds)
uses.partb: fra.fcerror library and sampler with the 'icon' slot = the as-of non-IFS mean (so 'cons' = C and the spread term = |IFS - non-IFS mean|), DEFAULT params unchanged, 200 paths, seed 0
uses.decision_model: fra.blend.decision_walk_forward unchanged (recent labels, lag 2) on those paths

gate: centre MAE of tw25 (as of, hourly issues) on the dev period valid 2026-04-02 .. 05-31 must be lower than the production consensus at leads 13-48; otherwise stop before the end-to-end run
primary_comparison: Brier(1,6,24,48) of blend_mm (0.5 * logit_mm + 0.5 * dec_mm) minus the champion reproduction (0.5 * logit + 0.5 * dec on the unchanged layer), long test issues 2026-06-01 .. holdout, valid < 2026-11-01, paired 1-day-block bootstrap 2,000 draws seed 20261105
clearly_wins: 95 % CI entirely below 0 on the long test AND negative point estimate on the pre-15-Sep part (valid < fra.evalkit.SELECTION_START) AND no lead (1/6/24/48) whose accuracy difference has a CI entirely below 0
if_clearly_wins: propose (not switch) a new pre-registered shadow variant; the champion and the locked holdout from 2026-11-01 stay untouched
holdout: no run, observation or label with time >= 2026-11-01 is fetched or scored here; fetch.py caps inits at 2026-10-31 18 UTC

clarifications.text: 'same definitions' includes the one feature derived from tw25_cons: xwf_east_tanh (fra.dataset.add_weather_extras, tw = tw25_cons.fillna(tw25)) is recomputed with the new consensus in run_e2e.mm_table, exactly as the live path (fra.multimodel) computes it. Found while writing the live module; no gate or end-to-end result existed yet.

outcome.consequence: no shadow variant; champion, registry, runtimes and the holdout untouched. The candidate live entry is kept as experiments/multimodel/live_entry.py (not in fra/, never run live).
